### Time with God - Feb. 16, 2011
Author: Time with God
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/timewithgod/time-with-god-feb-16-2011-11645798.html
Passage: Isaiah 55:1-3
Points:
- God freely invites everyone who is needy to receive what they could never afford.
- Grace means God paid the ultimate price for our forgiveness through Jesus Christ.
- Along with salvation, God provides purpose, eternal life, joy, and fellowship with His Spirit.
- Seeking fulfillment in worldly things is foolish and leaves the soul unsatisfied.
- Lasting spiritual abundance comes only when we come to God and live His way.
